description: Ideogram 4 text-to-image. Uses ideogram4_fp8_scaled with qwen3vl_8b CLIP, Ideogram4Scheduler, DualModelGuider, and flux2-vae. Supports structured JSON prompts. Presets: Quality (48 steps), Default (20 steps), Turbo (12 steps).

prompt.description: Text or JSON prompt for image generation

width.description: Output width. Rounded up to a multiple of 16 by the workflow.

height.description: Output height. Rounded up to a multiple of 16 by the workflow.

quality.description: Ideogram 4 scheduler preset: Quality, Default, or Turbo

final_cfg.description: CFGOverride value applied from start_percent to end_percent

batch_size.description: Number of images to generate per batch
